stories.title: Natural Resources Wales raises alert as rivers and wildlife feel the strain
stories.summary: Parts of north and south east Wales have moved to prolonged dry weather status, Natural Resources Wales confirmed on Wednesday. stories.title: Vehicle seized and wanted man arrested in Ewloe lorry checks
